rules.name: Impact engine changes need review
rules.rationale: Every safety decision in this runtime derives from the impact walk. A wrong weight or a mixed direction does not fail loudly - it quietly under-reports a blast radius, and the gate keeps returning verdicts that look fine.

rules.name: Command execution surface needs review
rules.rationale: This code runs child processes against source trees ingested from elsewhere. Its security properties hold by construction - no shell, no option-shaped arguments, allowlisted argv, rebuilt environment, containment resolved on the real filesystem - and a change here can remove one without any test noticing.
